candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out and the gateway returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order ReadTimeout, with postgres save_order failing DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5 in every sample. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; postgres-side evidence still needed to confirm saturation versus database unavailability.
missing_evidence: Postgres server-side connection/pool metrics (active, waiting, max connections) for the order service
Order service logs showing connection acquisition wait or pool timeout errors
Postgres availability/latency metrics to rule out database outage rather than pool saturation
